title: Create a 25-second fast-paced 9:16...
prompt:
Create a 25-second fast-paced 9:16 product reel for Yukti's predictive sales and demand forecasting. Focus on inventory confidence before placing supplier orders.

Narrative & Visual Flow:

Scene 1 (Hook, 0–5s): Bold kinetic typography with high-contrast text: "Next 7 days. Before you order." Spoken VO: "Here are the next 7 days of sales, before you place the order."
Scene 2 (UI Demo, 5–13s): UI screen showing Yukti's Sales & Demand Forecast. Historical trend lines transition into a dashed forward-looking 7-day estimate with confidence bands. Caption: "Sales next to expected demand."
Scene 3 (Proof / Trust, 13–20s): Zoom in on the green "Backtested Model" reliability badge and accuracy readout score. Caption: "Reliability score on every forecast." Spoken VO: "Each forecast has a reliability score, backtested against your past sales. Know what's coming, then order."
Scene 4 (CTA, 20–25s): Obsidian glass CTA pill with accent sweep: "Start 7-Day Free Trial". Subcopy: "Link in bio". Spoken VO: "See your own 7-day forecast on the free trial. Link in bio."

scenes.vo: In a world where everything was about to change.
Every step forward unveiled new horizons.
And there, at the horizon of tomorrow, destiny was forged.
